### 2026-11-06: This is the logged time for all the firmware testing I did. Sadly you can't put videos in the journal so you are just going to have to believe me that those motors are running. I tested the 9V motor a

**1.2h**

This is the logged time for all the firmware testing I did. Sadly you can't put videos in the journal so you are just going to have to believe me that those motors are running. I tested the 9V motor and the servo. But I also had to test the TV Remote to see what signals the different buttons made.

![Capture d'écran 2026-11-07 003359](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/nt9uCL85ZhJr8glvjKOMvMxUxWnp2cfs/24462271442b2f2fd89fff1e7e15f0692ee2b4080c34e87fbe91361d99c94843.png)

![Capture d'écran 2026-11-07 003446](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/nt9uCL85ZhJr8glvjKOMvMxUxWnp2cfs/0a67db44c1eb72a7be7843a7c067bfc2cb60f703f27a0e3ae5bc112dd2b6614b.png)

I also spent a lot of time trying to get the sound module to work. My original plan was to have the car stop if you clap but I am really sure the sensor is broken. That's also the reason why I decidded to go with the TV remote.
